notes: No winner or model weighting: a time-separated, weather-diverse holdout is required.
10-minute station wind observations differ from model 10m wind predictions.
Mountain forests can have different wind from public observing stations.
Hourly precipitation must be aligned by its one-hour accumulation end.
Quality-unverified observations, non-numeric and missing readings are excluded.
Not an official warning or a substitute for onsite safety procedures.
source_forecast: Open-Meteo model-specific snapshots, obtained before valid_at
source_observation: JMA AMeDAS public map data; values with quality flag 0 only
important_notice: This report is NOT a locally optimised forecast, forecast correction, or site-level wind measurement.

match_archive_progress.note: Pending matches are not yet in the immutable archive or sufficient for model correction.

notes: Thresholds are conservative pilot design goals, not universal WMO pass marks.
Counts are unique independent calendar days, not multiplied by hourly observations.
All three models must have the same station/time/lead to count as a fair cohort.
Wind >=8 m/s is a diagnostic regime, NOT a forestry work-stop threshold.
Rain, snowfall, rapid gusts, terrain effects, model-version changes and holdout skill need separate validation.
No day-of-month memorization; calendar effects are season/month and pre-known conditions only.
No auto-weighting, bias correction or safety judgments, even if these gates pass.
Private GPS and field sites are never used for the public research archive.
No grade is released without >=30 independent days; event skill requires >=15 event days.
Only the same public station, target hour and forecast lead where all 3 models have wind and precipitation count.
No ranking before an independent chronological holdout, confidence intervals and checks that severe-weather misses do not rise.
Monthly, seasonal, regional and day/night breakdowns are descriptive; no automatic personalised onsite correction.
8 m/s and 5 mm/h are RESEARCH event categories, not official warnings or site work-stop thresholds.
